## Scope
Statistical and theoretical approaches to economics; econometrics and dynamical-systems theory applied to economic and financial markets; theoretical and applied papers on nonlinear phenomena. Authors must assist replication by providing data and programs online.

## Scope Keywords
nonlinear dynamics, econometrics, financial markets, multiscale, fractal, time series

- Research article (theoretical, applied) — others UNVERIFIED
